svg.title: UPMS SRS v1.1 data model additions
svg.desc: Delta view of the UPMS data model after SRS v1.1: vendor settlement, payment and refund fields, staff assignment, bus active status, notification links and audit fields.
svg.text: UPMS · SRS v1.1 data model additions
Delta view since the complete ERD · vendor settlement, payment/refund, staff assignment and audit fields
Trip cancellation adds cancelled_at and cancellation_reason to Trip.
Existing ERDs remain valid for the original v1.0 model. This delta is the SRS v1.1 baseline; see SRS §7, §10 and §13.
Foreign keys: VendorSettlement → Vendor; Payment/Refund → Booking; TripStaffAssignment → Trip/Staff; Notification → Trip/Booking.
